successCriteria.description: The `policy -> leave-type` dependency edge remains present and is confirmed permitted by the committed dependency map: `.gestalt/architecture/reconciled.json` contains `{"from_":"policy","to":"leave-type"}` and `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` feature `7dc62161` lists `policy -> leave-type` among the allowed edges.

The import at `src/modules/policy/policy.service.ts` line 3 resolves through the leave-type module's public entry point (`src/modules/leave-type/index.ts`), which re-exports `ILeaveTypeService`, `LeaveTypeService`, and `PgLeaveTypeRepository` — no private-file reach-across.

`npm run build` is clean and the existing unit suite passes with no change to `PolicyService` runtime behaviour, its constructor signature, or the `createPolicyService()` factory's construction of `new PolicyService(new PgLeavePolicyRepository(), new LeaveTypeService(new PgLeaveTypeRepository()))`.

constraints: The `policy -> leave-type` dependency is a committed, allowed edge and must NOT be removed. The gate finding is a false positive; the resolution is to confirm the import is legitimate, not to eliminate it.

The import must continue to resolve through `src/modules/leave-type/index.ts` (the owning module's public entry point), never a private file such as `leave-type.service.ts` or `leave-type.repository.ts`.

No change to `PolicyService` class behaviour, its constructor signature, `IPolicyService`, or the `createPolicyService()` factory's construction expression. The `ILeaveTypeService` injected dependency and the `getLeaveTypeByCode` invariant (NotFoundError on unknown code) are unchanged.
outOfScope: Removing the `balance -> leave-type` and `leave -> leave-type` edges (PLAN.md Phases 2 and 3) — those are the actual still-unfixed violations and belong to separate phases, not this one.
Any change to `src/modules/balance/balance.service.ts` or `src/modules/leave/leave.service.ts` — this phase is confined to the policy module's dependency-direction finding.

entityInvariants.invariant: A LeavePolicy's `leaveTypeCode` must reference an existing LeaveType; `PolicyService.createLeavePolicy` enforces this via the injected `ILeaveTypeService.getLeaveTypeByCode`, throwing NotFoundError(404) on an unknown code. This invariant is unchanged by the phase.

interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: returns a fully-wired IPolicyService; no errors thrown

consistencyRequirements.requirement: The `policy -> leave-type` edge must match the committed dependency map exactly as recorded in the reconciled architecture.
The `policy -> leave-type` edge must match the allowed-dependency list in the committed architecture document (feature 7dc62161), which lists `policy -> leave-type` among the permitted edges.

The import must reuse the symbols re-exported by the leave-type public entry point (`ILeaveTypeService`, `LeaveTypeService`, `PgLeaveTypeRepository`), matching the symbols the entry point actually exports.
